scope: pending changes on branch fix/fragment-gate-and-monitoring-leak vs main (items 55-60 + monitoring leak fix)

findings.title: Sandbox escape via curated star-import module objects (arbitrary command execution)
findings.entry_point: evaluate_sage MCP tool (untrusted caller code path)
data_flow: rewrite_permitted_imports expands 'from sage.modular.dims import *' to explicit names incl. dirichlet (a module object)
_star_export_screen admitted dirichlet because module objects have no __module__, so the provenance check at line 462 returns '' and passes

validate_module approves 'alias = dirichlet.free_module_element.sage.env.os' because the terminal-segment rule (security.py:1238-1242) treats a forbidden parent 'os' under a non-allowlisted root as a benign method
alias is the real os module; alias.system('...') is unguarded (system removed from forbidden_attribute_names)
findings.impact: Verified live on SageMath 10.9: os.system executed and wrote /tmp/PWNED2 with uid=1001(sage); os.environ and os.getcwd readable. RCE on host in the default stdio (no-container) deployment; env/secret disclosure + outbound sockets even in the hardened container deployment.
findings.remediation: In _star_export_screen reject any export whose value is a types.ModuleType (drops sage.modular.dims and sage.rings.polynomial.real_roots), regenerate star_exports.py, and add a regression test running the reproducer through the untrusted path. Defence-in-depth: in security.py:1238 do not treat a forbidden parent as a benign terminal method when the chain root is a caller-bound import alias.

rejected.title: attrcall literal screening bypass
rejected.reason: Probed save/eval/dunder/write/bare-alias/non-literal forms; all refused. Benign literals pass and the runtime _guarded_attrcall re-screens with the same function.

rejected.title: Token-screen (item 55) scrubbed-name rescue via generator target
rejected.reason: Rescued scrubbed names are removed from sage.all, so naming them yields NameError; always_forbidden (call names + attr parents) is not overridden by the rescue.

rejected.title: Monitoring resource cross-client leak (post-fix)
rejected.reason: public_snapshot() pops the three free-text fields and MonitoringSnapshot no longer declares them; only process-wide aggregates reach the wire.
